name: modbee-mqtt
description: Function blocks that put an MQTT client inside an OpenPLC program. One node block covers every combination - MQTT 5.0 or 3.1.1, plain or TLS, on a board over WiFi, Ethernet or cellular, or on the Runtime - and hands itself to the other blocks, so a program can hold two brokers at once. Publish on demand or when a value moves, subscribe with a data quality that says how much to believe a number, announce yourself online and register the Will that says when you are not. A PLC can register itself with a provisioning key and keep the login it is given. A bridge carries topics between two brokers, and the PLC can be the site broker itself. Sparkplug B nodes keep their events through a link outage and send them afterwards flagged historical, and publish a table of daily totals on every birth. Every connection setting may change while running: the client reconnects by itself. Nothing here blocks: connect included, so a scan cycle never waits on a network.
